preregisteredRules.FRAME_PUBLICATIONS: 实时帧须逐项等于真实 open queue 的发布记录（顺序和原始 payload）
preregisteredRules.STATUS_RAW: durable status 须逐项等于独立读盘原文筛选的 entries
preregisteredRules.STATUS_COMMITS: 持久 status 须等于成功 commit journal，失败尝试不能算成功
preregisteredRules.STATUS_FIFO: 底层 status store 进入顺序须等于真实 writer 接纳顺序
preregisteredRules.REGISTRY_EVENTS: registry events 须逐项等于独立读盘快照，不能漏读
preregisteredRules.REGISTRY_RESULT: registry result 须等于独立读盘 result，覆盖不能被忽略
preregisteredRules.REGISTRY_RECORD: 完整 record/state/revision/lastSeq 须等于磁盘快照
preregisteredRules.REGISTRY_COMMITS: registry events 须等于实际成功 append journal，失败尝试不能算成功
preregisteredRules.REGISTRY_SEQ: registry seq 连续且 lastSeq/revision 与 events 一致
preregisteredRules.REGISTRY_FIFO: registry persist 进入顺序须等于 mutationChain 接纳顺序
